content: उदानः [अन्-घञ्] .²1 Breathing upwards. .²2 Breathing, breath in general. .²3 One of the five vital airs or life-winds which rises up the throat and enters into the head; the other four being प्राण, अपान, समान and व्यान; स्पन्दयत्यधरं वक्त्रं गात्रनेत्रप्रकोपनः . उद्वेजयति मर्माणि उदानो नाम मारुतः .. .²4 (With Buddhists) An expression of praise or joy. .²5 The navel. .²6 An eye-lash. .²7 A kind of snake.
